title: Refusals and notes with the wrong reason or remedy: options all switched off read as not enabled, a filled name-only command 'shadows the built-in', a non-executable handler is told to add itself, a declared --iex loses its summary
body:
FOUND 2026-09-23 by 0115's page agents, and driven again by cc at 4c9d5a7. Four places where devbin's refusal or note gives a reason or remedy that is not the true one.

1. A COMMAND WHOSE OPTIONS ARE ALL SWITCHED OFF IS TOLD SOMETHING ELSE IS WRONG. command_active makes a command with options inactive once none survives (lib/resolve:332-335). command_unavailable_reason then explains it as if the command itself were off:
- An opt-in with `enabled: true` and its one declared option `enabled: false`: "devbin ships it but this project has not enabled it (set commands.precommit.enabled: true)", exit 2 (lib/resolve:225-228). `help --why` says the same. DRIVEN.
- A language command: rust declared, and test's one option, test.rust, `enabled: false`. The refusal was "every option it offers is inactive here, so it would run nothing (declare project.languages in <config>, or commands.test.run)" (:245-248), though the language is declared. DRIVEN, through dormancy's legs.

2. DOCTOR SAYS A FILLED NAME-ONLY COMMAND SHADOWS THE BUILT-IN. With `commands.precommit.run` declared, doctor prints "precommit shadows the built-in" under "devbin's own is NOT reached for these". devbin ships nothing behind the name to reach. The command-level check (lib/cmd/doctor:392-394) has no filter, where the option-level one skips what is not @builtin (:395-401). DRIVEN. It predates 0113.

3. A NON-EXECUTABLE HANDLER IS TOLD THE WRONG THING. A file at bin/.devbin/cmd/<name> without +x is not a handler (lib/helpers:1238-1240). DRIVEN with precommit:
- With no `enabled:` key, the name is refused as "has not enabled it", exit 2.
- With `enabled: true`, the refusal says "declare commands.precommit.run or add bin/.devbin/cmd/precommit", exit 3 (lib/resolve:1031-1032), and that is the file it already has.
- Only doctor names the cause: a FAIL, with the chmod +x fix.

4. A DECLARED --iex LOSES ITS SUMMARY IN help. With `options.iex.commands` declared and no summary, help's shared-options block prints "--iex" and nothing beside it. _print_shared_options takes a config-declared option's summary from config alone (lib/help:382-399) and never asks framework_option_summary (lib/resolve:1215). DRIVEN. The undeclared control prints "--iex  Start the server in IEx rather than plain".

WHAT A FIX MUST DO. Each sentence names the true cause:
- options that are switched off are named as switched off;
- a filled name-only command is not reported as shadowing anything;
- a non-executable handler is named as one, with the chmod, at the refusal as doctor already does;
- help falls back to devbin's summary for an option devbin owns.

It ships in 0.1.8 under hv's ruling. vc's (vc, 2026-09-23).

## Resolution

Fixed at f484461. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. (1) command_unavailable_reason names options that config switches off: all of them, or some with the rest needing an undeclared language. It asks only where the command's own language is spoken, so db in a project without elixir is still told about elixir first. (2) doctor's command-level shadow check asks _ships_behind_name, so a filled name-only built-in such as precommit shadows nothing, while test, upgrade and docs still do. (3) nonexec_handler_hint names a file at bin/.devbin/cmd/<name> without its executable bit, with the chmod, in the exit-2 opt-in refusal and in unrunnable_why's exit-3 line. (4) help falls back to devbin's summary for an option devbin owns; a project's own option borrows nothing.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. 6 arms. Five are red on the code before the change, each for its reason. The sixth holds the language guard in (1), is green there by construction, and is proved by its mutant. 10 mutants, each parsing and each killed by its arm.
- REVIEW. cc approved it and reproduced the red first: 5 of 6, the guard arm green by construction.
- THE SUITE. The full suite on 0132 and this change together: 1..1677, 1677 ok, 0 not ok, 4 skips, rc 0, 14:51:33Z to 15:21:33Z.
